scope: Source integration tests against isolated external database protocol fixtures.
limitations: These results are source-test evidence only.
They do not validate a guest package install, daemon installation, upgrade, autostart, or service lifecycle.
Private fixture paths, credentials, and tokens are excluded.

tests.name: TestLiveManagedMongoCreatePermissionsBSONRestoreAndDelete
tests.reason: MongoDB uses a separate fixture and was run independently.

observed: Database and user permissions were exercised through the real MongoDB protocol.
BSON data and indexes were restored and checked.
Same-name database recreation remains typed-blocked pending an atomic ownership fence.

details: The initial MariaDB relay socket path exceeded the Linux Unix socket limit.
The configured local SQL tunnel was absent.
preflight_history.resolution: The test fixture was shortened and strict-host-key local SQL forwards were restored; the scoped SQL suite then passed.
